issues: The one-liner does not say what the Act did. s. 2 added an Explanation to Article 54 so that, for electing the President (Articles 54 and 55), 'State' includes the National Capital Territory of Delhi and Pondicherry, so their elected MLAs vote. s. 3 added Article 239AA(7)(b): a law under clause (7)(a) is not an amendment of the Constitution under Article 368.

Dates differ by section: s. 3 (Article 239AA) is deemed in force from 21 December 1991 (the site's date), but s. 2 (Article 54) came into force by notification only on 1 June 1995. The site could say so; 1991-12-21 is right as the first date.
